summary: Iteration 7 e2e testing of the two new features: (1) Customer Live Dispatch Status (GET /api/bookings/{id}/dispatch-status + SearchingStatus.jsx) and (2) Partner Missed Ring Recovery (GET /api/bookings/partner/missed + MissedRingRecovery.jsx incl. one-tap re-grab). Backend: 17/17 checks pass (16 in the persisted suite + the mutating re-grab class run once). Frontend: customer panel and partner missed-jobs card both fully functional, real accept flow verified end-to-end (AZO86EXXQ now assigned to Raj Kumar; customer panel disappeared and dispatch-status returns searching:false / partner_name='Raj Kumar'). Regressions (ring-pending, partner/jobs, partner/active, partner/dashboard, admin dispatch-timeline API, TestRingCard, Smart Snooze) all OK. Only one real (minor) bug found: the customer elapsed timer runs at ~2x speed.

minor.issue: Auth of a non-owner customer/merchant returns 403 (correct) but a non-existent id returns 404 only after _get_booking — fine; no defect. Noted for completeness: 'elapsed_sec' is computed from dispatch_started_at||created_at with no upper bound, so long-stale seed bookings report ~9,700s (2.7h) which the UI renders as '161m 40s' (no hours unit).

Response is capped at 12h/50 docs (by design) but does not exclude bookings the partner is already assigned/active on other jobs for; not observed to break anything in seed data. Also latency of the preview backend was intermittently 10-30s during this run (auth/verify-otp), which made one pytest run flaky (4 failed/6 errored) before passing 16/16 on 3 subsequent runs — infra latency, not code.

ui_bugs.issue: Elapsed timer counts ~2x too fast. `elapsed = st.elapsed_sec + tick` but `tick` is never reset when the 5s poll refreshes `st.elapsed_sec`, so both increase together. Measured 151m14s -> 151m22s over 3s of wall time. Fix: reset tick (setTick(0)) inside load(), or derive elapsed from a stored start timestamp.
fmtElapsed() has no hour unit — a 2.7h old search renders as '161m 40s'. Suggest 2h 41m formatting beyond 60 min.

Status filter chips (Pending/Searching/Assigned/...) and the row view (eye) action have no data-testid and are not role=button, and the search box only searches inside the currently selected status tab — so opening a 'searching' booking detail from the UI could not be automated (3 attempts). Admin dispatch-timeline API itself returns 200. Add data-testid to the status chips + row-view button.

issues: missed-ring-recovery renders at the top of PartnerAlertsPanel, which sits BELOW the KPI cards, earnings chart and 'Recent jobs' — i.e. far below the fold. Since the card is time-critical ('grab one before someone else does'), consider rendering it above the KPI row.

action_items: Fix double-counting elapsed timer in SearchingStatus.jsx (reset `tick` in load() or compute from a fixed start time).
Add hour formatting to fmtElapsed() in SearchingStatus.jsx.
Optional: move MissedRingRecovery above the partner KPI cards so it is visible without scrolling.
Optional: add data-testid to admin booking status filter chips and row view button to unblock automated Dispatch Timeline Map verification.
critical_code_review_comments: booking_routes.py: /partner/active and /partner/dashboard are declared AFTER the dynamic /{booking_id}/dispatch-status route. It happens to work (second segment differs), but any future 1-segment dynamic route (/{booking_id}) placed above them would shadow them — keep all static /partner/* routes grouped above every dynamic route. Verified both return 200 today.

customer_dispatch_status(): correctly leaks no partner identities while searching and excludes _id; good. It fetches up to 500 dispatch rows per poll at a 5s interval per searching booking card — with N searching bookings on the My Bookings page this is N requests/5s. Consider a single batched endpoint if a customer can have many searching bookings (seed customer had 2).

partner_missed_jobs(): missed_reason maps anything that is not None/'timeout' to 'taken_back', so an explicitly 'rejected' dispatch would show 'Request re-opened'; rejected partners are already filtered by rejected_partner_ids, so this is currently unreachable but is fragile.

MissedRingRecovery.regrab(): optimistically removes the row before/independent of onAccepted; on error it reloads — good. It disables ALL Grab buttons via a single `busy` flag (disabled={!!busy}) which is acceptable but slightly misleading UX.

rca_of_the_issue: Timer bug: SearchingStatus keeps a monotonically increasing `tick` counter (1s interval, never reset) and adds it to `st.elapsed_sec`, which is itself refreshed by the 5s poll to the server-computed elapsed time. Both terms grow with wall-clock time, so the displayed value advances at roughly 2 s/s. Reproduce: open /account -> My Bookings as +919000000004, read 'Searching for Xm Ys' twice 3s apart -> value advances ~6-8s.
